input.summary:
parts/room-7.mjs (B bedrooms) now places 19 blocks with no REFUSED and no OFF-PALETTE; make.sh wrote build.nbt.
The double bed (head and foot) is a spruce_slab, since palette.json has no bed; it reads as a low plank, not a bed.
Only the two legend entries changed; the layout and the other furniture are as drafted.
left: The palette has no bed block, so the focal double bed is a spruce_slab placeholder. A bed (or wool/bed-role palette entry) needs deciding by the architect or palette owner; this is not a fix I can make inside this part.
Walkability not checked here: ran make.sh only, not `mcd walk` or `mcd room` for B bedrooms.

waste.what: Finding which block was off-palette and why: make.sh reported only 'red_bed x2' with no cell or legend key, so I had to read the LEGEND by hand to see that B and F are the bed.
waste.cost: 1 full make.sh run (all 18 parts) plus one source read
waste.tool: runParts report should give the legend key and cells for each off-palette block (e.g. 'B -> red_bed at 12,13,13 ...'), and a 'closest palette block' suggestion.

waste.what: Choosing a replacement for red_bed by hand: no bed exists in palette.json, so I picked spruce_slab by reasoning about shape.
waste.tool: `$MCD blocks --check red_bed` returns only ids; a palette-aware suggestion (nearest palette block by footprint/height, or a flag that the palette has no bed family) would have answered it directly.

waste.what: Rebuilding the whole grid to see one part's line: make.sh reruns every part for a single-part fix.
waste.cost: 2 full builds to confirm the fix
waste.tool: a per-part run (e.g. build.mjs --only 'room: B bedrooms' against the last build) would let the part be checked in seconds.

companions.task: Choose a bed form for the focal double bed (head under the centre window, foot toward the room), so the palette can get a real bed block or a wool-and-wood stand-in for the room designer.
Confirm the dressing table and desk (spruce slab tops, stair-side desk) once the palette is settled, since the furniture was drawn with slabs and stairs only.
